title: ControllerDecision
description: One move in the plan/execute loop, chosen from the moves the policy layer declared legal for the current diagnosis and state. Structure is checked here; legality, monotone relaxation, locked constraints and budget are checked in policy.validate_decision, because none of them can be expressed against a single document.

action.description: accept: serve the results. repair_plan: the plan is broken in a way the planner can fix. relax_plan: the plan is valid but over-constrained; loosen exactly one axis. retry_execution: the plan is fine and the run did not finish; re-run with looser execution settings and no planner call. report_absence: the query ran to completion and the graph has no data for it. abandon: stop without an answer.

rationale.description: Why this move, in one or two sentences, referring to the diagnosis. Written to the audit trace and never shown to a user.

expected_change.description: What the next iteration should produce that this one did not. Recorded so a loop that keeps expecting the same change can be recognised as stuck.

relaxation_key.description: Required for relax_plan. The key of one axis from relaxation_options, formatted path_id:axis or path_id:axis:entity_ref. Exactly one axis is loosened per iteration so that an answer found afterwards can be attributed to a specific loosened constraint.

repair_focus.description: Optional for repair_plan. Which failures the revision should address, as unresolved:<entity_ref>, unsupported:<path_id>, or invalid:<location>.

execution_overrides.description: Required for retry_execution. Execution settings for the re-run. Every knob must loosen: a larger timeout, a larger result cap, or a smaller skip_direct_over_hops, which decomposes a multi-hop query sooner.
